checkpointPurpose: Implement durable, tenant-scoped Cal.com synchronization with authenticated webhooks, monotonic appointment state, resumable reconciliation, and bounded retry behavior.

decisions: Verify the webhook against the unmodified request body.
Pin the webhook payload version to 2021-10-20.
Pin reconciliation requests to API version 2026-05-01.
Throw a structured ConvexError inside the mutation so conflicting webhook identity writes roll back transactionally.
Use durable database state for leases, cursors, and idempotency.
Use experimental.useTypeScriptCli so Next.js invokes the bounded project-local TypeScript CLI instead of the hanging compiler API worker.
Run reconciliation through a protected cron route.
Retry only timeout, rate-limit, and server failures with an explicit attempt cap.

implementation.calendarValidation: Strict RFC3339 timestamps and canonical IANA time zones; ambiguous aliases such as CST and US/Central are rejected.
implementation.conflictHandling: The appointment mutation throws ConvexError code conflicting_webhook_identity; the HTTP boundary maps that code to status 409.
implementation.reconciliation: Durable tenant leases, expiry protection, bounded page count, validated cursor checkpoints, provider/persistence error separation, and failure-isolated tenant fanout.
implementation.rescheduling: rescheduledToUid records the superseded-by direction and prevents branching chains.
implementation.sequenceOrdering: Provider sequence comparison is applied only when the provider booking UID is unchanged; same-timestamp replacement across UIDs remains valid.

prerequisites.purpose: Convex TypeScript compatibility repair detected by the authoritative Vercel Preview build.

remoteRecovery.action: Publish the governed commit chain to a new recovery branch and Draft PR; do not force-push the old branch.
remoteRecovery.quarantinedReason: The candidate commit bypassed hooks and lacked required execution trailers.

reviewAudit.finding: Provider contract review found five defects; all were repaired and the shard was re-reviewed clean.
Convergence review found a transaction rollback defect and cross-booking sequence comparison; both were reproduced, repaired, and re-reviewed as addressed with no new Critical or Important findings.

stalenessAtCheckpoint.executionCursorFinding: The imported audited JSONL cursor still reports AUDIT-SECURITY-REMEDIATION instead of the live lifecycle checkpoint. Source and live cursor status must be exposed separately.
stalenessAtCheckpoint.resolution: Rebuild Graphify at this governed commit, sync graphify.db, and verify zero structural lag.
